chunk.content: Oreochromis mossambicus was the tilapia primarily distributed worldwide in the 1940s and 1950s; the Nile tilapia (O. niloticus), described by FAO as more desirable, was distributed from the 1960s to the 1980s.
chunk.source_quote: While significant worldwide distribution of tilapias, primarily Oreochromis mossambicus, occurred during the 1940s and 1950s, distribution of the more desirable Nile tilapia occurred during the 1960s up to the 1980s.

source.title: FAO Cultured Aquatic Species Fact Sheet: Oreochromis niloticus (Nile tilapia)
source.publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
